'''Slimfiend Is that you Dad''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Slimfiend]]
* '''Published:''' 17 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 TIGIH Slimfiend LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

while cleaning out my stuff i stumbled onto my swccg, my family had moved and i couldnt find a place to play. and the only chance i got was to go to cons and opens. some town people i noticed were carring the ole sealed deck boxes... i started chattin with them and they said they play and drive to misc places to play and i was welcome to come with them. the bad part is i dont have a single card past death star 2. i know there have been many improvements over the year or so... but let me know what i can change with this deck to make it better, for game play now. thanks.

its your simple cross vader falcon beat down deck...
